exchange: Schmitt repeatedly asks whether Smith went to a Warriors–Atlanta Hawks game on Feb 3 2024 in Atlanta; Smith: 'What city would that be in?… I definitely did not go to a Hawks game.' Schmitt says he has text messages saying otherwise. Press later reported a Hawks/Hawkeyes mix-up (see research/overseas_hearings_2026-10.md).
